data.name: Signal_DeathCross_Text
data.value: The short-term moving average has fallen below the long-term average (death cross) – a strong signal for a potential downward trend reversal.

data.name: Signal_LongTermLineBreak_Text
data.value: The price is trading below the long-term moving average. The longer it stays below, the more likely the break is structural rather than short-term weakness.

data.name: Signal_BearishMarketStructure_Text
data.value: The price forms lower highs and/or lower lows – the classic structure of an emerging downtrend.

data.name: Signal_MacdBearishCrossover_Text
data.value: The MACD line has crossed below its signal line – short-term momentum is weakening relative to the running trend.

data.name: Signal_RsiBearishDivergence_Text
data.value: The price reaches a higher high while the RSI forms a lower high – the strength behind the rise is fading (momentum loss).

data.name: Hint_Weakened
data.value: Individual reversal signals are present – the uptrend appears weakened.

data.name: Hint_ReversalLikely
data.value: Multiple or strong reversal signals are present – a downward trend reversal is likely.

data.name: Status_InsufficientData_Text
data.value: There is not enough price history for an evaluation.

data.name: Status_Intact_Text
data.value: No bearish reversal signals were detected.

data.name: Status_Weakened_Text
data.value: The sum of signal strengths does not yet reach the threshold for a likely trend reversal. The signals may also be false signals or a normal correction.

data.name: Status_ReversalLikely_Text
data.value: The sum of signal strengths reaches the threshold for a likely trend reversal – several independent indicators point downward at the same time.

data.name: Meaning_Score
data.value: Each signal contributes 1 (weak), 2 (moderate) or 3 (strong) points to the signal score depending on its strength. From a score of 4 the reversal is considered likely.

data.name: Meaning_Disclaimer
data.value: Reversal signals are statistical hints, not a guarantee of falling prices. False signals are possible especially in sideways phases and with low liquidity.

data.name: Aria_Info
data.value: Show explanations of the reversal signals

data.name: Formula_Text
data.value: SMA{0}/SMA{1} = average close of the last {0}/{1} days; MACD = EMA12 − EMA26, signal = EMA9; RSI = Wilder RSI(14); market structure = swing highs/lows of the recent trading days

data.name: Detail_Swings
data.value: {0} of {1} highs and {2} of {3} lows lower than their predecessor
